dataLimitations: Reference metadata only. Source entries are secondary-review records and are not proof of current exchange listing or tradability.
Every included record is marked unverified and requires manual verification before any use in a live-trading workflow.
Country fields identify a known exchange market, not company headquarters. Euronext is multi-country and therefore has no inferred country value here.
The source does not provide dependable sector or company-logo data for this file; those values are null rather than guessed.
